title: Youngstown, OH — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Youngstown, OH: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Youngstown is a city in OH with a population of 65,000. Steel Valley city with Youngstown State University and the Butler Institute of American Art. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree.

Last updated: September 12, 2026
